description: Geneseed's vendored, modified versions of the obra/superpowers skills (Jesse Vincent, MIT): brainstorm, debug, plan, code review and review response. Turn it off when the official superpowers plugin is installed; keep one of the two.

skills: | [brainstorm]({{DIR_SKILLS}}/brainstorm.md) | a new feature or project with no design yet, or whose goal, scope, or success criteria need pinning down first |
| [debug]({{DIR_SKILLS}}/debug.md) | a bug or failure to diagnose before fixing — a red CI run or pre-merge check included, reproduced under CI's conditions |
| [plan]({{DIR_SKILLS}}/plan.md) | a task has more than a couple of steps |
| [review-response]({{DIR_SKILLS}}/review-response.md) | acting on review feedback you have received |
